existing_content_walk.scene: An already-built RM_GelatinousSlime review map on the composed biomes package, with a liquid current, blank seeker, two colonists and antidote. Use the archive dialog, follow the mark, complete extraction, inject and order the friend treatment through ordinary UI. A separate view can show stages-one-and-five Titanoslimes. The exact review save has not been verified in this read-only stage.
existing_content_walk.observations: Measures current legibility of the chosen-gene journey, coma clock, real friend treatment and current art before design is extended. Technical archive reunion and chunk/vault scenes can follow with the already recorded owner answers.
existing_content_walk.recovery_requirement: The authorised live runner records scene-begin recovery before state changes and either restores with scene-end or holds the review with scene-hold. This proposal performs no game action.

protocol.acceptance_readiness: All new scene_<id> entry points require the filed script item before scheduling acceptance. Existing audited helpers remain component probes.
protocol.recovery: Before mutation, persist scene-begin with a named recovery save and fingerprint plus exact map/global/settings snapshot. Include terrain/filth/plants, pawn ids and holders, health/genes/relations/memories, items, weather and its lock, camera/selection/time, research, archive entries/vats, campaign state and fixture ids as applicable. In finally restore the saved entry state and exact settings, remove all fixture products including corpses and held/world pawns, independently compare the manifest and only then scene-end. An interrupted or unequal recovery stays open. An owner-review scene uses scene-hold with the named save and an explicit review deadline, then recovers on release.
protocol.classification: PASS, FAIL and UNMEASURED name their evidence. Missing service/identity/observer is UNMEASURED. A completed wrong outcome is FAIL.
protocol.floor: All DLC assumed. Existing data/biome metadata is inspected read-only. The inherited no-generation rule remains applicable. Dwommo live movement is owner-attended.
